recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. No further core source change is needed for FHIR-46397 unless the work group wants unrelated cleanup of the replacement Device.name example values.
issue_request: FHIR-46397 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and asked to remove Device.displayName because Device.name, especially Device.name.display, now covers the intended display-name use case.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged commit 8f12564689e826c075bc9ecf889e953c244614aa commented out the active Device.displayName element and replaced specimen-container example displayName values with Device.name entries, but left commented-out displayName XML in the active StructureDefinition source and examples.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini and the edited specimen-container examples are referenced by source/device/list-Device-examples.xml. Earlier FHIR-22113 and FHIR-39162 history explains the introduction and replacement of Device.displayName, and 2024-07-15 OO HCP minutes confirm the 9-0-0 motion to remove it. A current build.fhir.org XML example still exposed the old displayName line as a comment, making the cleanup visible spec-surface reconciliation rather than private source polish.
reconciliation: Removed the commented Device.displayName element block from source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml and removed the commented displayName lines from the five active specimen-container Device examples. The release-note text that intentionally documents the element removal remains.
